summary: testrrrd postinstall + import-time beacon to hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint
details: testrrrd@2.0.1 is a no-op stub whose only functional behavior is calling back to a hardcoded operator endpoint. beacon.cjs collects host metadata (hostname, install path, cwd, Node.js version) and POSTs it as JSON to http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The beacon fires from a postinstall lifecycle hook so it runs automatically on npm install, and index.js also calls require('./beacon.cjs').fire() at module load, so any require() of the package re-triggers the callback. index.js otherwise exports a Proxy of no-op functions, so the package provides no advertised functionality beyond the beacon. The destination is a bare IPv4 address with no TLS and is not user-configurable, and the hostname + filesystem-path fields identify the installer host to the endpoint operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
